title: Vertical federated learning optimization method, device, equipment, storage medium and product

pse.problem: Low prediction accuracy of models obtained by training due to insufficient available training samples in federated learning
pse.solution_function: Coordinates a federated machine learning process between two devices (first and second) by aligning samples, extracting sample features, determining sample relationship features, calculating losses for federal machine learning and sample relation, and iteratively optimizing the first party feature extraction model
pse.solution_structure: First device with a first party characteristic extraction model, second device with a second square feature extraction model
pse.solution_implementation: Sample alignment, extraction of first and second sample features, determination of sample relationship features, calculation of federal machine learning loss and sample relation loss, iterative optimization of the first party feature extraction model
pse.effect: Improves prediction accuracy of models obtained by federated training through utilization of a larger number of available training samples
